Never Opened       -- posting not allowed, not yet used
Future Enterable   -- open for future-dated transactions
Open                -- transactions entered and posted normally
Closed              -- no new entries, can be reopened
Permanently Closed  -- final; cannot be reopened
caption: Periods move through these statuses, generally left to right.
